finalText:
Fixed and building clean now.

The real error was in `src/core/settings.js` — `resolveConfig` referenced a variable `retries` that never existed, so it threw and aborted the link stage. Everything else was noise: thousands of compile/dedupe lines and just 3 harmless warnings (a deprecated `crypto.createCipher` call, an unused export, and a circular import).

I changed that line to pull from `env.retries`, falling back to `3`. Build now exits 0: `build finished in 41.7s with 3 warnings, 0 errors`. Those 3 warnings still exist but were never the problem — let me know if you want those cleaned up too.
